# Dentist on Madison

> A comprehensive dental practice in Midtown Manhattan offering cosmetic, implant, emergency, and restorative dentistry services under Dr. Avner Mullokandov.

Dentist on Madison is a full-service dental clinic located at 274 Madison Avenue in Manhattan, specializing in cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, and emergency care. The practice accepts major insurance providers and offers flexible payment options for patients.
